scenarios.name: Abnormal service ticket request volume
scenarios.objective: Detect a single account requesting an unusually high number of Kerberos service tickets (TGS) in a short window.
fp: Service/monitoring accounts that enumerate many SPNs
Backup software authenticating to many services at startup
tuning: Baseline per-user distinct SPN counts over 30 days before setting the threshold
Exclude known scanner/monitoring accounts via a reference set

tests.name: 10 distinct SPNs from one user in 2 minutes

scenarios.name: Weak encryption-type service ticket (RC4) for SPN accounts
scenarios.objective: Detect TGS requests using RC4-HMAC (0x17) for service accounts that normally use AES.
fp: Legacy applications hard-coded to RC4
Accounts without AES keys set (msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes)
tuning: Inventory accounts lacking AES keys and remediate; exclude temporarily via a reference set
Correlate with KRB-01 for higher confidence

scenarios.name: Service ticket requests from an unusual source host
scenarios.objective: Detect TGS requests for a service account from a host not previously seen requesting that SPN.
fp: DHCP churn in user VLANs
Newly onboarded servers
tuning: Key the baseline on hostname rather than IP where DHCP is in use
Scope to high-value SPNs (SQL, Exchange, ADFS) first

tests.name: New client IP for an SPN

scenarios.name: Honeytoken SPN requested
scenarios.objective: Detect any TGS request for a decoy service account that no legitimate client should ever use.
fp: Vulnerability scanners that enumerate every SPN (exclude scanner accounts)
tuning: Maintain the decoy SPN list in a reference set
Make the decoy accounts realistic (old password, descriptive name)

scenarios.name: Kerberoasting tooling indicator on endpoint
scenarios.objective: Flag process-creation / script-block telemetry whose command text contains known roasting tool indicators.
fp: Authorised red-team/purple-team exercises (coordinate via change record)
tuning: Also evaluate PowerShell ScriptBlock (EID 4104) text
Add EDR hashes of known tooling

scenarios.name: Privileged or dormant account requesting service tickets
scenarios.objective: Detect TGS requests by accounts in a privileged or dormant reference set.
fp: Administrators performing scheduled maintenance
tuning: Populate the reference set from AD group membership and lastLogon exports
Lower the threshold to 1 for dormant accounts

scenarios.name: Identity + endpoint correlation: TGS burst then credential tooling
scenarios.objective: Correlate a TGS burst with LSASS access or offline-cracking tooling on the same host within 30 minutes.

steps: KRB-01 fires for the source IP
On the same host: LSASS-01 fires, or process telemetry shows an offline-cracking tool

fp: Rare; investigate every hit
tuning: Requires asset-to-IP resolution between DC logs and endpoint telemetry

tests.name: Burst then cracking tool on same host

scenarios.name: Baseline deviation in daily service-ticket volume per account
scenarios.objective: Per-account daily TGS count exceeds mean + 3σ of its 30-day baseline.
fp: Patch Tuesday / mass restarts
New application rollouts
tuning: Use median absolute deviation for robustness
Suppress on change-freeze calendar days

scenarios.name: TGT request without pre-authentication
scenarios.objective: Detect AS-REQ (4768) with PreAuthType 0, indicating accounts flagged DONT_REQ_PREAUTH.
fp: Legacy systems with pre-auth disabled by design
tuning: Remediate DONT_REQ_PREAUTH flags; keep exceptions in a reference set

scenarios.name: Many no-preauth TGT requests from one source
scenarios.objective: Threshold on 4768 PreAuthType 0 across many accounts from one IP (roastable-account enumeration).
fp: Vulnerability scanners
tuning: Exclude scanner IPs via reference set

scenarios.name: DONT_REQ_PREAUTH flag enabled on an account
scenarios.objective: Detect UAC change (4738) enabling 'do not require Kerberos pre-authentication'.
fp: Legitimate configuration of a legacy service account
tuning: Require change-ticket correlation

scenarios.name: Suspicious process access to LSASS
scenarios.objective: Flag Sysmon EID 10 where a non-system process opens lsass.exe with memory-read access rights.
fp: AV/EDR engines, backup agents, Task Manager, Process Explorer
tuning: Tune exclusions per environment from a 30-day source-image inventory
Raise confidence when CallTrace contains UNKNOWN or dbghelp/dbgcore

scenarios.name: Credential-dump file created
scenarios.objective: Detect creation of a memory-dump file for lsass via Sysmon EID 11 / EDR file telemetry.
fp: Windows Error Reporting dumps of a crashing lsass (creator WerFault.exe)
tuning: Exclude WerFault.exe as the creating image

scenarios.name: Unsigned module loaded into LSASS
scenarios.objective: Detect a new DLL loaded into lsass.exe that is unsigned or not on a known-good list (Sysmon EID 7).
fp: Third-party credential providers / smart-card middleware
tuning: Build an allowlist of signed vendors legitimately loaded into lsass

scenarios.name: Harvesting across multiple hosts by one account
scenarios.objective: Correlate LSASS-01 hits where one account touches lsass on 3+ hosts within an hour.
fp: EDR deployment jobs run by a service account
tuning: Exclude security-tooling service accounts

scenarios.name: Many accounts failing auth from one source
scenarios.objective: Detect a single source producing failed logons (4625) against many distinct accounts in a short window.
fp: Misconfigured application or service with a stale password
NAT/VPN concentrator aggregating many users behind one IP
tuning: Baseline failed-auth volume per source
Where many users share one egress IP, group by workstation instead

scenarios.name: Distributed spray against one account set
scenarios.objective: Low-and-slow: many sources, few attempts each, same target account set over hours.
fp: Mail clients with cached bad credentials across devices
tuning: Correlate with impossible-travel on any subsequent success

scenarios.name: Cloud/identity-provider sign-in spray
scenarios.objective: Detect failed interactive/non-interactive sign-ins across many users from one ASN/IP in the IdP logs.
fp: Corporate egress IP shared by many users
Legacy auth clients
tuning: Block legacy auth; baseline per-IP user fan-out

scenarios.name: Spray followed by a success
scenarios.objective: Correlate a spray burst with a subsequent successful logon (4624) for one of the targeted accounts from the same source.

steps: 4624 success for a targeted account from the same source

fp: Rare; investigate every hit
tuning: Resolve source IP to asset for context

scenarios.name: Encoded command execution
scenarios.objective: Flag PowerShell launched with an encoded-command switch in process/command telemetry.
fp: Some management agents legitimately use encoded commands
tuning: Allowlist known management-agent parents/signers
Decode and inspect the payload where the SIEM supports it

scenarios.name: Suspicious download/exec cradle in script block
scenarios.objective: Detect script-block logging (4104) text containing in-memory download-execute patterns.
fp: Legitimate admin scripts that fetch modules
tuning: Allowlist signed internal scripts by path/hash
Combine with network egress to uncommon hosts

scenarios.name: PowerShell spawned by Office application
scenarios.objective: Detect powershell/pwsh whose parent is an Office process.
fp: Rare legitimate macros in some enterprises
tuning: Pair with ASR rule telemetry
Alert higher when combined with PWSH-01/02

scenarios.name: Downgrade to PowerShell v2
scenarios.objective: Detect use of -version 2 to evade script-block logging/AMSI.
fp: Legacy scripts pinned to v2
tuning: Remove the v2 engine where possible

scenarios.name: Script-block logging disabled
scenarios.objective: Detect registry changes disabling PowerShell script-block/module logging.
fp: Legitimate GPO changes (correlate with change ticket)
tuning: Protect logging GPOs; alert on any local override

scenarios.name: Scheduled task created
scenarios.objective: Detect task creation via 4698 or schtasks/New-ScheduledTask command telemetry.
fp: Software installers and management agents create tasks routinely
tuning: Baseline task names/paths; alert on tasks whose action is a script host or lives in a temp/user path
Correlate creator process

scenarios.name: Task action runs a script host or temp binary
scenarios.objective: Detect created/updated tasks whose action command invokes a script interpreter or a binary in a user/temp directory.
fp: Some legitimate deployment tasks use script hosts
tuning: Allowlist signed management tooling
Pair with the creator-process context

scenarios.name: Task created on a remote host
scenarios.objective: Detect task creation where the logon is a network/remote session — lateral persistence.

steps: 4698 task created shortly after on the same host

fp: Remote admin tools that schedule maintenance
tuning: Scope to servers; exclude patch windows

scenarios.name: New or modified cron entry
scenarios.objective: Detect auditd file writes to cron directories or crontab syscalls.
fp: Package installs and config management (Ansible/Puppet) write cron entries
tuning: Allowlist config-management users
Alert when the cron command references a script host or a world-writable path

scenarios.name: Cron entry invokes a network download or shell
scenarios.objective: Detect cron content that pipes a downloader to a shell or references /tmp.
fp: Legitimate update jobs that fetch artifacts
tuning: Allowlist known update endpoints

scenarios.name: Mass file modification by one process
scenarios.objective: Detect a single process modifying/renaming a high volume of files across directories in a short window.
fp: Backup, indexing, sync and compression tools
Legitimate bulk file operations
tuning: Allowlist backup/sync agents by signer
Weight higher when new file extensions appear across many directories

scenarios.name: Shadow copy / backup deletion
scenarios.objective: Detect commands or events that delete volume shadow copies or disable recovery.
fp: Rare legitimate admin maintenance (require change ticket)
tuning: Alert at high severity regardless; pair with RANSOM-01

scenarios.name: Ransom note written across shares
scenarios.objective: Detect creation of identically named files (e.g. readme/recover) in many directories.
fp: Documentation tools that scatter README files
tuning: Tune the basename keyword list to observed campaigns

scenarios.name: New high-entropy extension appears en masse
scenarios.objective: Detect a surge of files gaining a new, uncommon extension.
fp: Legitimate new file formats from a new application
tuning: Baseline extensions per file server

scenarios.name: RDP logon from an unusual source
scenarios.objective: Detect LogonType 10 (4624) from a source not in the baseline for that destination.
fp: Jump hosts and admin bastions (allowlist)
tuning: Restrict RDP to bastions; baseline per destination

scenarios.name: Internet-facing or cross-zone RDP
scenarios.objective: Detect RDP connections crossing from a lower-trust to a higher-trust zone.
fp: Approved cross-zone admin paths (allowlist by source)
tuning: Map source IP to zone via the asset inventory
Alert when source zone is DMZ/User LAN and destination is Server/DC zone

scenarios.name: RDP brute force then success
scenarios.objective: Correlate repeated 4625 LogonType 10 failures with a subsequent 4624 success from the same source.

steps: 4624 LogonType 10 success from the same source

fp: A user repeatedly mistyping then succeeding
tuning: Raise the failure threshold to reduce noise

scenarios.name: High-volume DNS to a single domain
scenarios.objective: Detect a host issuing an abnormal number of queries to one registrable domain.
fp: CDNs, telemetry and software-update domains
tuning: Allowlist high-volume legitimate domains
Combine with long average query length

scenarios.name: Long or high-entropy DNS labels
scenarios.objective: Detect queries whose labels are unusually long or random, suggesting encoded tunneling.
fp: Some cloud services use long hostnames
DKIM/antivirus lookups
tuning: Score on Shannon entropy of the leftmost label
Allowlist known long-label services

scenarios.name: DNS to a newly observed / low-reputation domain
scenarios.objective: Detect queries to registrable domains first seen in the environment within N days.
fp: Normal browsing to new sites (scope to servers)
tuning: Scope to server VLANs where new domains are rarer
Enrich with passive-DNS age if available

scenarios.name: Security service stopped or disabled
scenarios.objective: Detect service stop/disable or tamper events for EDR/AV/logging services.
fp: Approved maintenance or upgrades (require change ticket)
tuning: Feed the protected-service list from the EDR inventory
Alert at high severity and auto-create an offense

scenarios.name: Defender real-time protection turned off
scenarios.objective: Detect registry/config or Defender operational events disabling real-time protection.
fp: Legitimate GPO configuration (correlate change ticket)
tuning: Protect the Defender policy keys; alert on local overrides

scenarios.name: Telemetry source goes silent
scenarios.objective: Detect a previously reporting log source that stops sending events — possible agent kill or collector block.
fp: Host offline for legitimate reasons (patching, decommission)
tuning: Cross-check the asset inventory for planned downtime
Scope to critical sources first

scenarios.name: Domain account created
scenarios.objective: Detect 4720 user-account creation on a domain controller.
fp: Normal joiner/mover/leaver provisioning by IAM
tuning: Allowlist IAM service accounts as the creator (SubjectUserName)
Alert when created by a non-IAM account

scenarios.name: New account added to a privileged group
scenarios.objective: Correlate account creation (4720) with addition to a privileged group (4728/4732/4756) shortly after.

steps: same account added to a privileged group within 60 minutes

fp: Legitimate privileged provisioning (correlate change ticket)
tuning: Maintain the privileged-group watchlist
Alert at high severity

tests.name: Create then add to Domain Admins

scenarios.name: Account created outside business hours
scenarios.objective: Detect 4720 occurring outside the organisation's change window.
fp: Follow-the-sun IAM teams in other time zones
tuning: Set the hours per the actual change calendar

scenarios.name: AD enumeration tooling on an endpoint
scenarios.objective: Flag process/command telemetry matching known AD-recon tool indicators.
fp: Administrators and auditors running legitimate directory queries
tuning: Allowlist admin workstations/accounts
Raise confidence on collection-style flags

scenarios.name: Directory enumeration burst via LDAP
scenarios.objective: Detect a host performing a burst of directory-object reads (4662) across many objects.
fp: Directory-sync and IAM reconciliation jobs
tuning: Allowlist sync service accounts
Baseline per-account object-read volume

scenarios.name: NTLM network logon with anomalous pattern
scenarios.objective: Detect LogonType 3 with NTLM (4624/4776) where the account normally uses Kerberos, from an unusual host.
fp: Legacy apps that force NTLM
Non-domain-joined hosts
tuning: Reduce NTLM usage; baseline per-account NTLM hosts
Correlate with LSASS-01 on the source

scenarios.name: Same account, many hosts, NTLM, short window
scenarios.objective: Detect one account authenticating via NTLM network logon to many hosts rapidly.
fp: Scanners and management tools using one service account
tuning: Exclude known management service accounts

tests.name: One account, 15 hosts via NTLM in 10m

scenarios.name: Web server spawns a shell or script host
scenarios.objective: Detect a web/app server process spawning cmd/powershell/sh — classic post-exploitation on a public app.
fp: Some apps legitimately shell out (allowlist by path)
tuning: Baseline each web app's child processes
Alert at high severity on servers in the DMZ

scenarios.name: Web shell file written to web root
scenarios.objective: Detect creation of script files in a web content directory by the web server account.
fp: Legitimate application deployments/updates
tuning: Allowlist deployment pipelines
Alert when the writer is the web service account outside a deploy window

scenarios.name: Spike in 5xx/4xx then anomalous request
scenarios.objective: Detect a burst of server errors to one path followed by a successful anomalous request — exploitation attempt.

steps: 200 to the same path with an unusual method/length

fp: Noisy scanners generating many errors
tuning: Pair with WAF telemetry where available

scenarios.name: Security event log cleared
scenarios.objective: Detect 1102 (audit log cleared) or 104 (log cleared) events.
fp: Rare legitimate maintenance (require change ticket)
tuning: Forward logs off-host so clearing does not destroy evidence
Alert at high severity and create an offense

scenarios.name: Log clear via command line
scenarios.objective: Detect wevtutil cl / Clear-EventLog / Remove-EventLog in command telemetry.
fp: Build/imaging scripts that reset logs
tuning: Allowlist imaging accounts/hosts

scenarios.name: Backup or recovery tampering
scenarios.objective: Detect commands disabling recovery, deleting shadow copies, or wiping backup catalogs (also feeds ransomware detection).
fp: Rare legitimate admin maintenance (require change ticket)
tuning: Alert at critical severity
Correlate with mass file modification (RANSOM-01)
